summary: X-13 is a PUBLIC static legal placeholder page. description.md, functional-spec.md, and screen-data-summary.md all agree the screen does NOT read or write any DB. The implementation (src/app/terms/page.tsx + src/components/legal/TermsContent.tsx) renders antd Typography/Card from next-intl i18n strings only — no Supabase client, no RPC, no table read. The screen-data-summary.md '정책 본문/버전/공개 일자' row carries a '스키마 보강 필요' LABEL, but per the CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL rule its 확정 계약 + 메모 are authoritative: '약관 본문, 버전, 공개 일자, 적용 일자를 운영 데이터로 관리하는 구조는 없다' and '동의 이력과 함께 설계할 수 있다' — i.e. a deferred, out-of-scope future design tied to consent-history, NOT a current screen need. description.md states no concrete DB query/validation/render need (it explicitly describes hard-coded placeholder copy and Link escapes). Therefore the only DB-shaped requirement is routed to schema-gap/unresolved as a deferred, escalate-not-apply item; everything else is satisfied-by-static-content (no liveDbObject expected).
